name: Chloé Audiard
original_name: クロエ・オーディアール
source: An adventurer who goes to Melcriti Academy. She specializes in summoning, and is the one who (accidentally) summons Yuuki. However, for some reason, Chloe lost majority of her power, for which the cause is unknown. Despite this, Chloe is a hardworking girl who optimistically goes through everything.
